verification_policy: Batched readability workflow: exact token substitution for alpha-only edits; review event routing, callback order and live/cached reads for structured edits. One target build. Native comparisons reserved for uncertain behavior; reccmp refresh deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability reconstruction of existing Modern Horizons 2 card handlers and helpers. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim. Preserve native quirks, repeated queries, context reads and opaque dialogs.
review_notes: Fifty-nine alpha-only definitions preserve exact tokens after declared local substitutions. Thirty-two structured definitions receive source review and one batch build.
Retain channel versus ordinary activation routing, alternate costs and fizzle distinctions, repeated grave queries, target validation/mode rechecks, zero-count and source-death behavior.
Keep GFP helper eligibility and detach differences, Magus status gating before resolution and byte flags, Carth low-byte counts and cleanup kills, and duplicate legacy searches.

Keep Said/Done ability-query and delegated resolution order, Blessed Respite context refresh and AI queries, Garth cached used-mask/record and six ordered availability checks, and Saga chapter/mana/token distinctions.

Keep Dihada and Out of Time first-player snapshots, live second-player reads, reverse selection/action order and cached counts/targets across callbacks; Rise and Shine retains live collection bounds followed by reverse animation.

Verdant Command preserves two choices in order and native per-mode target index changes, including no advancement for life gain; keep the human-path uninitialized dialog priorities, confirmed in native disassembly. Rift Sower has one pre-existing descriptive-label jump outside this batch.
Opaque dialog implementations remain out of scope. No new native semantic comparison cases, full historical replay or reccmp refresh.

native_priority_review.conclusion: Human path branches from 0x022430d6 through 0x022430df and reads the priority locals at 0x022430df-0x0224311f without prior initialization. Existing native quirk retained and documented; no gameplay-equivalence claim.

status: Applied readability batch. One target build and coverage receipt follow; reccmp refresh is deferred to a larger checkpoint.
